Founder & strategic connector

Meet Jaime Lane

With roots in Lake Norman dating to 1983, Jaime Lane has built her work around people, relationships, and results. Her experience spans economic development, organizational culture, workforce challenges, program design, business collaboration, and strategic partnerships.

She doesn't just offer consulting. She helps navigate challenges that call for someone who understands people, partnerships, and systems—and knows how to bring the right capabilities together.

Jaime is the founder of LINK Lake Norman, BUILD6™, LINK Community Hub™, and the Executive Visionary Circle™, and also founded Seasons of Giving Lake Norman.
